summary: Juvenility determination under Juvenile Justice Act, 2015; appellant's age conclusively established as 15 years 4 months 20 days at time of incident via school records; ossification test rejected where primary school documentation available; death sentence set aside due to juvenility; appellant entitled to release after 5 years incarceration exceeding statutory maximum 3 years under s.18 for juveniles below 16 years convicted of heinous offences; validity of documents per s.94(2)(i) confirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection) Act, 2015 s.9(2)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection) Act, 2015 s.18
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection) Act, 2015 s.94
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; death sentence set aside; appellant declared juvenile and entitled to immediate release.
